slug: 2024-03-15 The Executive invites parents to register children in the Civil Registry and adults over 18 to obtain the DIP

systems.system: DIP (Documento de Identidad Personal) and CNEDOGE's nationwide DIP tour plan
systems.tiers: a planned nationwide tour; the DIP is obligatory from age 18

note: The Vice-President urged registration of minors in the national civil registry and stricter enforcement of the DIP (15 March 2024), and officials complained that registered data on minors are hard to reconcile with reality; nothing on how the civil record is made or on any digital system.
